summary: Apply the three formatting-only repairs so pending questions contain only their question text.

items.title: 1. Priority label embedded in question text
items.rationale: The priority is already recorded in the requirement-level draft fields and should not appear in a pending user question.

items.title: 2. Priority label embedded in question text
items.rationale: The priority is already recorded in the requirement-level draft fields and should not appear in a pending user question.

items.title: 3. Priority label and rationale embedded in question text
items.rationale: The question should request a decision without embedding its recommendation or rationale.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[2].question starts with should: and includes an explanatory outcome.
